title: Independently audit PR6167 numerical compiler premises
body:
The published PR6167 compiler recipe passes an independent integer/rational reconstruction of its numerical hypotheses. The least complement-capacity power at theta=63/64 is 1013: the older PR6030 value 1012 fails, while the published 1024 remains valid. The sufficient threshold stays N=2^65807000000000 (first grid index 47005). **No new κ.**

This addresses the numerical compiler handoff in #6214. It extends #6109's older-invoice audit using a separate integer-square-root implementation; #6245 covers outer arithmetic. The threshold and root-enclosure method are credited prior work, not new claims.

[Research package, exact certificate, proof and validation](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/b0d4342772acf661a249daa9fd36d53c9a7ef1ed/research/p104-6167-compiler-audit)

Base: `2485805a6d47f36ea83ddde6327d453ac82d44dc`.
Source heads:
- #6167: `564a076b113621a93edc4e39968ee4e4a8c9caf0`
- #6214: `ee8b66c91510b1ff4e5d28be8c6567810b4b3d01`
- #6109: `729842c7a3ea54d5f8a17bfb20dd528fd8d736a5`

Theorems and seven input files are hash-pinned in SOURCES.json; original-head bytes and ancestry were checked. Published commit: `b0d4342772acf661a249daa9fd36d53c9a7ef1ed`. Its complete Git tree equals the tested tree.

Reproduce from repository root with CPython 3.12:
`python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-6167-compiler-audit`
Expected: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Executed: normal/optimized registered replays, 4,100 independent arithmetic-oracle cases, 18 semantic controls (including power 1012, preceding grid point, forged intervals and an equal-mass paid mutation), four parser/arithmetic rejection cases, seven source-byte corruption controls and one receipt corruption. Committed-byte/mode/history checks and read-only Git-free export replays passed. No hosted CI or full selected cold replay claimed.

Scope: fixed-source numerical theorem instantiation, not a new supplier admission, full-theorem formalization or native/caller replay. The native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape and analytic_recovery assumptions remain. No selected record or upstream/ changes. Remaining physical/interface obligations are not discharged.

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0. Credit Ali Romman (#6167), Matarener (#6214), JosieElliston (#6109), concurrent AAAmirinu (#6245), and the theorem/construction and arithmetic predecessors named in the package.
